label: Bible Study
prompt: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were _____.
verse: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
note: The Red Sea crossing — note the strong east wind blew all night; the miracle had a night shift.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Mercy unto you, and peace, and _____, be multiplied.
verse: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
note: Jude's greeting is a triple helping — mercy, peace, and love — and he wants all three multiplied.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Greet all the brethren with an holy _____.
verse: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
note: Paul's closing instruction: greet the brethren with an holy kiss — he says it in four different letters.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy _____ from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
verse: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
note: Before Jericho, Joshua meets the captain of the LORD's host and gets Moses' burning-bush instruction.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the times of this ignorance God _____ at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verse: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
note: 'God winked at' past ignorance — overlooked it — but now commands all men everywhere to repent.
